title: Mohnish Pabrai VALUEx BRK 2026
description:
AI, India, Dakshana, and a Charlie Munger 
Story On fear and greed as opportunity, the risk to India if it lacks foundational AI models, the Dakshana sewing-machine story, and the legendary Munger "tell him about the blonde" story.

See the full stream of the event here: https://youtube.com/live/V3V7bqLGP9o
summary: The video argues that there is an investment opportunity in Constellation Software (CSU) driven by irrational market perspectives regarding AI. The speaker suggests that incumbents in this space may achieve cost reductions and gain advantages on the acquisition side. This view implies that the current market pricing may not fully reflect these potential benefits.
